extraFunctions.name: can_update_invoice
extraFunctions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_update_invoice(p_invoice invoices)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    nullif(public.current_finance_user_id(), '') is not null
    and nullif(public.finance_current_verified_google_email_v2(), '') is not null
    and p_invoice.tenant_id = public.current_tenant_id()
    and (
      public.is_finance_accounting()
      or public.json_steps_include_current_user(p_invoice.steps)
      or (public.json_steps_role_matches(p_invoice.steps)
        and public.finance_role_queue_scope_v1(p_invoice.department_code,p_invoice.entity_id))
      or p_invoice.applicant_id = public.current_finance_user_id()
    )
$function$

extraFunctions.name: current_finance_user_name
extraFunctions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_finance_user_name()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select (public.current_finance_user()).name
$function$

policies.name: invoices_delete_ceo_only
policies.using: ((tenant_id = current_tenant_id()) AND (NULLIF(current_finance_user_id(), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (NULLIF(finance_current_verified_google_email_v2(), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (current_finance_role() = 'ceo'::text))

policies.name: invoices_insert_authenticated_requester
policies.check: ((tenant_id = current_tenant_id()) AND (NULLIF(current_finance_user_id(), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (NULLIF(finance_current_verified_google_email_v2(), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (is_finance_accounting() OR (applicant = current_finance_user_name()) OR (applicant_id = current_finance_user_id())))

policies.name: invoices_select_scoped
policies.using:
((tenant_id = ( SELECT current_tenant_id() AS current_tenant_id)) AND
CASE
    WHEN ( SELECT is_finance_accounting() AS is_finance_accounting) THEN ( SELECT ((NULLIF(current_finance_user_id(), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (NULLIF(finance_current_verified_google_email_v2(), ''::text) IS NOT NULL)))
    ELSE can_read_invoice(invoices.*)
END)
